## WHAT WAS BUILT

1. tools/race-collect.py — mechanical collection + blinding: gathers lane-<id>/ dirs from a race root, copies artifacts byte-identically to <blind-dir>/<sha256[:16]>.md content-hash names, verifies no self-attribution inside artifacts (canonical model labels, capitalized family proper nouns, first-person family self-claims — vocabulary synced with the G4 sanitizer in tools/bakeoff.sh, including the deliberate case discipline where lowercase minimax/glm are NOT family mentions), verifies no lane committed to git (git ls-files under the lane dir, or a nested .git), emits the judge's blind set with stdout carrying ONLY hash names (never the lane mapping), a self-sealed sidecar manifest.json, and a compliance report collect-report.json. Exit contract: 0 = clean (or missing-artifact-only), 1 = blinding-relevant breach (SELF-ATTRIBUTION / GIT-COMMIT) — blind set REFUSED, a leaked set is worse than none, 2 = harness error (incl. re-collection over a sealed manifest).

2. tools/regression-race-collect.sh — controls, red-first, all green at write time (6 arms): ARM 1 seeded 'I am Claude' caught (exit 1, lane named, no blind set, empty stdout); ARM 2 null run over clean untracked lanes in a scratch git repo (exit 0, 2 blind files whose names re-hash to their content, stdout carries only hash names, manifest self-sealed and mapping exactly the two lanes, report clean); ARM 3 a lane committed to git (scratch repo) caught as GIT-COMMIT (exit 1, lane named, no blind set); ARM 4 missing-artifact lane excluded + noted, rest blinded (exit 0); ARM 5 re-collection over a sealed blind dir refuses (exit 2); ARM 6 lowercase minimax/glm NOT flagged while 'as a DeepSeek model' IS. RED OBSERVATION recorded as the standing rule demands: the test was written and run first — all arms failed with exit 127 (collector absent) before the instrument existed; the three ARM-2 failures during bring-up were TEST bugs (15 hex groups instead of 16 in the filename pattern; the manifest-check python opened the race root instead of blind/manifest.json; grep 'breach' matched the 'breach_count' key) — fixed in the test, not by weakening the collector.

3. Race W retro-mark — one record appended to docs/epics/E1-markovian/L1-dashboard/S02-model-delegation/grand-race-ledger.jsonl (race: race-w-terminology, event: verdict, audit_status: unaudited, written_by: T779-race-protocol-v2, verdict = the ADJUDICATED outcome from the T757 disclosure). The standing path is 'written by the harness'; the retro-mark is a recorded exception per seed ruling §4 rule 5, so the record names its writer. The ledger was re-validated line-by-line (72 lines parse OK). Re-grading Race W and changing past committed text were both out of scope and untouched.

4. Ledger schema (R6) — the two-field write lands on the existing grand-race-ledger.jsonl grade/outcome record as two REQUIRED fields: verdict (adjudicated winner(s) per section/criterion, structured JSON) + audit_status (audited|unaudited; audited only via a different-family confirming judge, recorded with audited_by + audit_date). model-perf (docs/infra/model-perf.md + model-task-metrics.jsonl ingestion) consumes audited results only — the refusal is at the consumer, mechanical, not at the producer, disciplinary.

Until wired, 'zig build test' does NOT run this regression — the tooling-acceptance gate is not yet fully closed and the suite must not be reported green-for-T779.

- STALE PATHS in two existing instruments (recorded, not fixed — neither file is held by this row): untracked/race-aspects/write-ledger.py and tools/race-p0-verify.sh both reference 'docs/infra/races/grand-race-ledger.jsonl' and 'docs/infra/races/grand-race-p0-fixtures.sha256', but the 2026-08-20 refactor (commit 966da63, 'refactor S2: home races + t11/t12 under S02-model-delegation') moved both files to docs/epics/E1-markovian/L1-dashboard/S02-model-delegation/. docs/infra/races/ does not exist on disk. write-ledger.py would fail on its next real run (append into a non-existent dir); race-p0-verify.sh's fixture-seal check reads the old path. A future run of either instrument would silently check nothing. Worth a defect row: the refactor that moved the files did not sweep its own callers.
